design.decision: Play winners back to back every round (cash a suit before switching), because each pair also adds to the run-long total.
design.opponent: Revealed the first time it grows; opponents break runs by taking the lead whenever they can and by switching suits.
design.rationale: Run-long growth belongs at rare; the earlier growth seeds failed on rare conditions (17-28% fire), so this one grows on the most frequent Streaks trigger (about 90% of rounds, several times per round), like the kept cb-grow-make-mult.
design.draftText: This sigil gains +1 contract multiplier every time your team wins consecutive tricks (currently +0)

critic.concerns: Fires several times a round, so it can snowball to large totals; opponents can respond by breaking runs.
